candidates.name: slower_trend
candidates.rule: Existing crossing rule with SMA50/200; all other entry-independent settings unchanged

candidates.name: channel_breakout
candidates.rule: At closed bar t, buy if close[t] exceeds max(high[t-20:t]) and close[t-1] did not exceed max(high[t-21:t-1]); sell symmetrically below prior lows. Slices exclude their right endpoint. Equality is not breakout.

candidates.name: range_reentry
candidates.rule: Compute z[t] using close[t] and the trailing 20 closes through t, population standard deviation. Buy when z[t-1] < -2 and z[t] >= -2; sell when z[t-1] > 2 and z[t] <= 2. Reject zero deviation.

candidates.name: fixed_condition_selector
candidates.rule: If efficiency >= 0.35 use C02; if efficiency <= 0.20 use C03; otherwise no trade. Zero denominator means no signal. Never combine position sizes.

evaluation.initial_samples: Existing eligible January, April, July 2024 only; reused development, not unseen validation
evaluation.equal_comparison_start: Use a common evaluation start after 201 observed closed bars for every candidate; no warmup trades. Freeze exact UTC bounds before running.
evaluation.reserved_validation: November-December 2026; not evaluated or scheduled here
